title: Symmetrized seed distribution
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-coordinate sign cube, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree that computes $f$ for every seed. The symmetrized seed law on pairs of a symmetry of $f$ and a seed of $T$ is obtained by choosing the symmetry uniformly and the original seed according to its seed law, independently.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the sign cube
Randomized decision tree computing $f$ for every seed
Finite seed space with its probability law
